notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 - Hotfixes
notes.notes:
The bug caused by the previous update has been fixed.
My apologies for any inconvenience this may have caused.

The fixes are as follows
・The problem that sometimes an invisible jump-scare occurs.
・Enemy cries were sometimes not heard when clearing the game.
・Enemies behave strangely depending on where they appear.
The problem that the viewpoint operation becomes unstable depending on the FPS setting.
・I have also found other issues and can reproduce them.

I will fix other problems as soon as I can find or reproduce them.

Also, I have updated the development software to make development more comfortable.
Due to this, a large number of files will be updated when the game is updated.
If you have any problems, please feel free to contact me.

notes.title: Multiple enemy action patterns added
notes.notes:
Hello!

I have made the following updates
1...I have divided Puppet's behavior types into three types. She will run, hide, or sneak up behind you.
2...I have adjusted the difficulty level according to the above.
・Normal: Changed the number of enemies to 3.
・Hard: The number of enemies that act has been changed to four.
・Nightmare: Changed the number of enemies to five.

3...Bug Fixes
・Fixed an issue where the cursed statue destruction gauge would progress while posing.
・Fixed a problem that the UI for canceling the interaction does not appear when you try to destroy a cursed statue in a crouching state.
・Changed the description of mouse sensitivity to camera sensitivity.
・Other minor changes.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Defect Fixes
notes.notes:
The following fixes have been made
・Fixed a problem in which enemy footsteps did not sound.
・Fixed a problem in which the player's hair and other parts of his or her body would be transferred when the enemy attacked.
・Fixed an issue where the viewpoint would remain focused on the enemy when attacked at certain times.
Fixed an issue with enemies moving during the clear movie.
・Fixed a problem where item outlines were visible through walls.

I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
I will continue to make every effort to improve the product.

notes.title: In-game convenience improvements, other bug fixes and progress
notes.notes:
In-game convenience improvements, other bug fixes and progress

Hello everyone!
I have made the following modifications to the system.

Fixes
・Reflected translations provided by volunteers.
・Addition of stamina gauge
・The time to run out of stamina was changed to 20 seconds.
・Change in the speed of stamina recovery
・Changed the game menu so that the number of cursed statues remaining can be checked from the game menu.
・Fixed a bug that prevented achievements from being unlocked.
・Fixed a bug that caused item effects to be triggered when equipping weapons under certain conditions.
・Other minor adjustments

Thank you for your ongoing bug reports and requests.
If you have any problems with this update, please feel free to post a comment.

The new map is in the works!
It is still going to take some time and I hope to be able to add some maps for mini-games.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Translation data will be made available to improve translation quality.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

To improve translation quality, we have released translation data.
You can see the translation data from the following URL.

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1TW3x3TyCpkCzjIEEhdj4RLgQPFHFZVpyddBEe7tCO8g/edit?usp=sharing

The spreadsheet's comment function allows you to point out translations.
Right-click in a cell to select the comment function.
When you leave a comment, your account name will be displayed, so if you are not comfortable with this, please log out of Google and you can write anonymously.
If you'd like to help, please let me know!
I wish I was good at languages other than my own....

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me by posting in this news thread or otherwise.

I look forward to continuing to work with you!

notes.title: Consideration of adding a new map
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Thank you for enjoying the game!
Thanks to your feedback, the game is being improved little by little.

I am currently thinking of starting work on adding a new map.
The approximate shape of the game rules for the new map has been decided, so I'll let you know.

[h3]Overview[/h3]
・Considering adding new maps.
・New maps will be added in free updates.
・The new map will have new game rules.

[b]Previous maps[/b].
The previous map was a mission to destroy a cursed statue, and had a lot of running, hiding, and action elements.

[b]New Map[/b].
In the new map, we'd like to reduce the action elements a bit and increase the strategic elements.
In other words, it's all about using the gimmicks in the map to win.

For the time being, we would like to create a new map based on the following ideas.
・Eliminate items and use the gimmicks in the map.
・Players can use gimmicks in the map to guide enemies.
・If the enemy spots you, you can only escape if you meet certain conditions.

The gameplay will be different from before.
The above information alone is vague, but if you feel free to comment on anything, it would be appreciated.
Comments such as "It would be interesting to have such a rule!" Are also welcome.

Also, since this is a personal development, it may take a while to add maps.
I would appreciate it if you could wait patiently.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Difficulty adjustment update. Other bug fixes.
notes.notes:
[h3]Difficulty has been adjusted. [/h3]

[b]The following changes have been made to the difficulty level. [/b]
・Removed easy mode and added hard mode.
・Increase in overall difficulty
・Decrease in the number of medical kits
1player (9~12) => (7~10) 
4player (9~12*1.5) => (7~10*1.5)

[h3]Other bug fixes[/h3]
・Fixed a bug in which the icon and the activated skill were mismatched when using multiple potions.
・Fixed an issue where the clear movie would not play on the client side.
・Solved a problem that made it difficult to pass through the door when lagging was occurring.
・Reduced the load on the GPU for the player character's hair.

[h3]I am looking forward to hearing from you. [/h3]
If you have any problems, please feel free to post them in the thread.
I hope you continue to enjoy the game.

notes.title: Currently adjusting the difficulty level.
notes.notes:
The following is a message from the management.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
I am receiving a stern rebuke from a very special customer.
The customer said, " People's confusion, death, these are not enough." I was told.
There are too many people surviving in the game, and the policy is to reduce them as much as possible.

In line with this, we are giving her some adjustment work.
She may behave as she always has, or she may behave in a way not seen before, depending on the difficulty level.

We will let you know when the adjustment is complete.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[list]
[*]With the revision of all difficulty levels, the previous Easy mode will be removed and a Hard mode will be added.
[*]Normal mode will be the minimum difficulty, but the difficulty will be slightly higher than the previous Normal mode.
[*]The number of medical kits will be revised.
[/list]
